rows.expected_limit: Distant planar background and nearer target probe calibration transfer; a small envelope is not a certificate.

rows.label_zh: c002 各视图一致看错深度
rows.expected_limit: All views consistently measure a rod at 1.25x target depth. Fixed wrong correspondences may be stable; the envelope need not detect this.

rows.label_zh: c003 各视图一致看错横向杆
rows.expected_limit: All views consistently measure a parallel wrong rod displaced by 0.12m. Stability may remain high while target accuracy is wrong.
No training, validation or rod observations. Group fitting must explicitly skip and rod geometry must remain absent.

rows.label_zh: c005 体积背景／远杆／低噪声
rows.expected_limit: Farther rod amplifies angular error; envelope is an empirical sensitivity diagnostic.

rows.label_zh: c006 体积背景／近杆／低噪声
rows.expected_limit: Informative background and wide baseline; reference control, no promise of a particular numerical score.
Each rod endpoint has only one view; no triangulated rod output is admissible.

rows.label_zh: c008 窄基线／远杆／高噪声
rows.expected_limit: Combined narrow baseline, distant rod and noise; uncertainty may be large or deceptively small.
Two declared finite segments; known endpoint correspondence and segment order are analytic assumptions.

rows.label_zh: c010 一个视图端点对应交换
rows.expected_limit: Endpoint identities are exchanged in view 2. Wrong pixels remain fixed in every fold; spread is not a correspondence validator.
Single-depth background with a farther target; report geometry error separately from spread.

rows.label_zh: c012 体积背景／近杆／高噪声
rows.expected_limit: Larger independent measurement noise; do not require every random instance to rank monotonically.
Whole camera layout scaled down tenfold while noncollinearity ratio is preserved.

rows.label_zh: c014 体积背景／远杆／高噪声
rows.expected_limit: Combined depth and pixel-noise stress; no post-hoc threshold fitting.

rows.label_zh: c015 背景与杆共享像素偏移
rows.expected_limit: One fixed per-frame pixel shift affects background and rod alike. Training resampling cannot guarantee detection of shared systematic bias.
Single-depth background weakens calibration evidence; not guaranteed to produce a failure.

scope: Descriptive fixed-condition ranges, no algorithm changes, new thresholds, confidence intervals, or automatic promotion
p95_direction: finite truth target to predicted curve
fold_metric_policy: Fixed four rows; valid empty-prediction recovery=0 participates; undefined precision and missing metrics remain null; each range reports valid count
box_containment_policy: 33 same-fraction samples per segment, equal segment weight, endpoints included, not arc length
